jobs_policies.name: job_events_read
jobs_policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE (job.id = job_events.job_id)))

jobs_policies.name: jobs_insert
jobs_policies.check: ((NOT eps.jobs_dispatch_mode()) AND (requested_by = auth.uid()) AND eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'enqueue'::text) AND (status = 'queued'::text) AND (stage = 'prepare_document'::text) AND (attempt = 0) AND (current_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (lease_token_digest IS NULL) AND (dispatch_generation = 1))

jobs_policies.name: jobs_read
jobs_policies.using: (eps.jobs_dispatch_mode() OR eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'read'::text) OR eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'enqueue'::text) OR eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'operate'::text))

jobs_policies.name: jobs_workspace_identity
jobs_policies.using: ((archived_at IS NULL) AND eps.project_scope(project_id, false) AND (eps.has_capability('workspaces.read'::text) OR eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text) OR eps.has_capability('operations.read'::text) OR eps.has_capability('operations.retry'::text)))

jobs_policies.name: outbox_insert
jobs_policies.check:
(eps.jobs_dispatch_mode() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE ((job.id = outbox_events.job_id) AND (eps.jobs_can_access(job.workspace_id, 'enqueue'::text) OR eps.jobs_can_access(job.workspace_id, 'operate'::text))))))

jobs_policies.name: outbox_read
jobs_policies.using:
(eps.jobs_dispatch_mode() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE (job.id = outbox_events.job_id))))

jobs_policies.name: specs_submit_outbox_read
jobs_policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs visible_job
  WHERE ((visible_job.id = outbox_events.job_id) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_job.workspace_id, true))))

policies.name: specs_source_inputs_submit_insert
policies.check:
(eps.specs_scope(workspace_id, true) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE ((job.id = specs_source_inputs.job_id) AND (job.workspace_id = specs_source_inputs.workspace_id) AND (job.resource_id = specs_source_inputs.spec_id) AND (job.requested_by = auth.uid()) AND (job.kind = 'specs_extract'::text) AND (job.input_hash = specs_source_inputs.input_hash) AND ((job.input ->> 'source_hash'::text) = specs_source_inputs.source_hash) AND ((job.input ->> 'source_row_version'::text) = (specs_source_inputs.source_row_version)::text)))))

policies.name: specs_stage_apply_audit
policies.check:
((action = 'jobs.apply_specs'::text) AND (client_type = 'api'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (eps.specs spec
     JOIN eps.jobs job ON ((job.id = spec.processing_job_id)))
  WHERE ((spec.id = audit_events.resource_id) AND (job.requested_by = audit_events.principal_id) AND (job.correlation_id = audit_events.request_id)))))

policies.name: specs_submit_audit_insert
policies.check:
((principal_id = auth.uid()) AND (action = 'specs.submit_specs'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.specs visible_spec
  WHERE ((visible_spec.id = audit_events.resource_id) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_spec.workspace_id, true)))))

policies.name: specs_submit_audit_read
policies.using:
((principal_id = auth.uid()) AND (((action = 'jobs.enqueue'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs visible_job
  WHERE ((visible_job.id = audit_events.resource_id) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_job.workspace_id, true))))) OR ((action = 'specs.submit_specs'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.specs visible_spec
  WHERE ((visible_spec.id = audit_events.resource_id) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_spec.workspace_id, true)))))))

policies.name: specs_submit_idempotency_insert
policies.check:
((principal_id = auth.uid()) AND (operation = 'specs.submit_specs'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs visible_job
  WHERE (((visible_job.id)::text = (idempotency_records.response ->> 'job_id'::text)) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_job.workspace_id, true)))))

policies.name: specs_submit_idempotency_read
policies.using:
((principal_id = auth.uid()) AND (((operation = 'specs.submit_specs'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs visible_job
  WHERE (((visible_job.id)::text = (idempotency_records.response ->> 'job_id'::text)) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_job.workspace_id, true))))) OR ((operation = 'jobs.enqueue'::text) AND (key ~~ 'specs.submit:%'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs visible_job
  WHERE (((visible_job.id)::text = (idempotency_records.response ->> 'id'::text)) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_job.workspace_id, true)))))))

policies.name: specs_submit_outbox_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs visible_job
  WHERE ((visible_job.id = outbox_events.job_id) AND eps.specs_scope(visible_job.workspace_id, true))))

constraints.name: roles_source_origin_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((source_job_id IS NULL) OR ((spec_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_role IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: roles_source_origin_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, spec_id, source_job_id) REFERENCES eps.specs_source_inputs(workspace_id, spec_id, job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: specs_extraction_origin_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((source_extraction_job_id IS NULL) OR (source_extraction IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: specs_extraction_origin_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, id, source_extraction_job_id) REFERENCES eps.specs_source_inputs(workspace_id, spec_id, job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: specs_pipeline_config_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT enabled) OR ((document_preparation_version IS NOT NULL) AND (model_version IS NOT NULL) AND (prompt_version IS NOT NULL) AND (result_schema_version IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: specs_pipeline_config_document_preparation_version_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((document_preparation_version IS NULL) OR (((length(document_preparation_version) >= 1) AND (length(document_preparation_version) <= 200)) AND (document_preparation_version = btrim(document_preparation_version)))))

constraints.name: specs_pipeline_config_model_version_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((model_version IS NULL) OR (((length(model_version) >= 1) AND (length(model_version) <= 200)) AND (model_version = btrim(model_version)))))

constraints.name: specs_pipeline_config_prompt_version_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((prompt_version IS NULL) OR (((length(prompt_version) >= 1) AND (length(prompt_version) <= 200)) AND (prompt_version = btrim(prompt_version)))))

constraints.name: specs_pipeline_config_result_schema_version_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((result_schema_version IS NULL) OR (((length(result_schema_version) >= 1) AND (length(result_schema_version) <= 200)) AND (result_schema_version = btrim(result_schema_version)))))

constraints.name: specs_source_inputs_job_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, spec_id, job_id, input_hash) REFERENCES eps.jobs(workspace_id, resource_id, id, input_hash) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: specs_source_inputs_spec_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, spec_id) REFERENCES eps.specs(workspace_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: specs_stage_payloads_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((stage = 'prepare_document'::text) AND (prepared_text IS NOT NULL) AND (paragraphs IS NOT NULL)) OR ((stage = 'extract_specs'::text) AND (prepared_text IS NULL) AND (paragraphs IS NULL))))

constraints.name: specs_stage_payloads_job_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES eps.jobs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
